llmProvider.title: LLM provider
llmProvider.description: Set up and manage LLM provider credentials — provider, model, base URL and API key per profile. Which profile is used for which use case is set under "Model assignment".

llmAssignment.title: Model assignment
llmAssignment.description: Which LLM provider profiles are used for which use case — overrides the server-side ENV configuration without a redeploy. Additional profiles are tried in order as a fallback when the current model is rate-limited, over quota, or otherwise unavailable.
llmAssignment.usingEnvDefault: No override set — the server default is active: {provider} ({baseUrl})
llmAssignment.usingTranslationFallback: No translation override set — translations currently use: {provider} ({baseUrl})
llmAssignment.usingInsightFallback: No override set — currently uses the document extraction assignment: {provider} ({baseUrl})
llmAssignment.strategyFallbackHint: Every auction starts at the first profile; the others only step in when it is unavailable. Right when the list is a quality ranking.
llmAssignment.strategyRoundRobinHint: Consecutive auctions alternate between the profiles. With profiles on different API keys this multiplies the per-minute quota — the quota is per project and model. If the models are not equivalent, some auctions get the weaker one.
llmAssignment.fallbackHint: If a model is rate-limited, over quota, or otherwise unavailable, the next entry in the list takes over.
llmAssignment.chainLimitReached: Maximum of {max} profiles per use case.

osmImport.title: OSM location data
osmImport.description: Loads sea/lake/river/mountain/airport/ski data per country from OpenStreetMap extracts. A country with no data yet gets loaded automatically on the daily run; a country that already has data is never reloaded automatically again — only a manual reimport here triggers that.
osmImport.pending: Requested at {at} — will be processed on the next daily run.

geoMetrics.title: Environment filter calculation
geoMetrics.description: Precomputes each auction's distance to sea/lake/river/mountain/airport/ski (from the OSM location data above) — the search's environment filters only read these precomputed values. Runs daily automatically, but can also be triggered here right away, e.g. after a manual OSM reimport.
geoMetrics.rebuildStarted: Rebuild started — runs in the background and can take several minutes. Check progress via "Refresh status".

externalData.title: External data sources
externalData.description: POI/transit, noise, flood risk and market comparison on the detail page come from these services. An empty field falls back to the deployment-configured (env var) value, if set — otherwise the source stays inactive.

objektDetail.landValueBaselineDisclaimer: Official land values are a land-value baseline, not comparable sale prices for built residential property.
objektDetail.externalDataDisclaimer: External market and natural-hazard data is not a substitute for official due diligence.
objektDetail.extractionNotice: Key facts automatically extracted from the appraisal/brochure ({confidence}).
objektDetail.translationError: The translation could not be loaded.
objektDetail.sourcesDisclaimerText: All information provided without guarantee. PropHammer accepts no liability for the accuracy or completeness of the information shown.
objektDetail.safetyNoticeText: Under German law (§§ 67–70 ZVG), bidders may be required to provide security at the auction hearing, usually 10% of the market value, payable immediately. Cash payment is not accepted; bidding proxies must be publicly certified.
objektDetail.noNearbyPlaces: No larger nearby places found in the evaluated area.
objektDetail.noExternalLocationContext: No external location details are available for this site yet.
objektDetail.publicTransportStops: {near} public-transport stops within 1 km, {wider} within 3 km.
objektDetail.locationContextDisclaimer: Approximation derived from OpenStreetMap tags. It does not replace an on-site check; building condition is only visible where it has been mapped.
objektDetail.reportedNoiseTitle: Reported noise exposure (EU Environmental Noise Directive)
objektDetail.reportedNoiseHint: Officially reported noise contours under the EU Environmental Noise Directive. Only available for mapped agglomerations and major transport routes.
objektDetail.airQualityHint: Modelled values from the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service on a ~11 km grid — they describe the surrounding area, not the parcel itself.
objektDetail.climateNormalsHint: Climate normals ({start}–{end}), averaged per calendar month from the Open-Meteo historical archive (ERA5-Land reanalysis, ~9-11 km grid) — a normal, not a forecast, and it describes the surrounding area rather than the parcel.
